Monday.title: Be ready for the Release Cut...
Monday.description: Prepare your work, and have all possible reviews before going to Staging on Wednesday.
checklist: 🔍 Request reviews on everything you have open
🧪 Get CI green early, not on Wednesday morning
🔗 Link each PR to its ADO ticket

Tuesday.title: The Release Cut is tomorrow...
Tuesday.description: It’s time to check if your work is really ready for Staging.
checklist: 🚦 Confirm your work is genuinely Staging-ready

Wednesday.title: Release Cut Day!
Wednesday.description: The release cut will be made around 8pm PST.
checklist: 🛑 Merge before 8pm PST, or wait for the next cut
👀 Watch for the release branch to appear
🧯 Raise blockers in this channel before the cut

Thursday.title: DEPLOYMENT DAY!
Thursday.description: The production deployment will be made around 9pm PST.
checklist: 📋 Verify your changes on Staging before tonight
🆘 Stay reachable during the deploy window
🔎 Sanity-check production once it is live
